revision_to_prior_candidate.finding: R6 reconcile_pending_head_commits mutates public ConversationState fields outside a ConversationState context. Exact upstream __setattr__ autosaves each changed public field when _save_depth == 0. R6 _save_base_state simultaneously increments persistence_generation and deletes every marker whose base_generation is older. For a multi-event pending chain, adopting the first event can therefore persist an intermediate HEAD and delete markers for later events before they are committed. A process crash at that point leaves later durable events markerless and no longer safely recoverable.
revision_to_prior_candidate.why_with_state_alone_is_not_enough: Upstream __exit__ flushes dirty state even when exiting because of an exception; therefore a repair that mutates incrementally inside `with self:` and only later discovers ambiguity/unreachability can still persist a partial repair. Validation must finish before the first public-state mutation.
revision_to_prior_candidate.required_shape: two-phase recovery: parse and exact-validate the complete marker/event chain against the persisted HEAD and generation using local variables only; compute final leaf/head_is_empty/last_user_message_id; fail closed on ambiguity, future generation, digest/parent mismatch or unreachable marker with zero durable state mutation; only then perform one batched state commit and allow generation-based marker cleanup after the base snapshot wins.
revision_to_prior_candidate.scope_limit: This is a source-level crash-safety finding for the R6 candidate and exact OpenHands v1.44.1 APIs. It is not evidence that upstream OpenHands currently contains the candidate bug, because R6 was never applied upstream.
